text:
maya: heads up — started a slow promotion of v2.4-int8-lite to 5% for short-form queries (<=256 tokens). seeing early quality drift on legal/finance evals.
samir: can you paste the A/B snapshot? which metrics are drifting?
maya: quick snapshot: avg_latency +12ms, token_cost -28%, rouge-L -0.6 on legal_eval_2026, qa_exact_match -1.8%. experiment id exp-2026-03-20-01. not per-user visible yet.
aj: -1.8% QA for legal sounds outside our tolerance. what's the rollout gating threshold? thought auto-fallback triggers at >1.0% regression for precision.
diane: our org default is 1.5% for generic tasks, but legal/regulated should be 1.0% — we should treat this as high-risk :warning:
maya: here's the rollout policy snippet we used:
```
rollout:
  initial_traffic: 0.05
  steps: [0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50]
  metrics:
    - name: qa_exact_match
      direction: higher_is_better
      auto_fallback_threshold: -0.010   # absolute
    - name: rouge_L
      direction: higher_is_better
      auto_fallback_threshold: -0.005
  special_handling:
    legal:*:
      auto_fallback_threshold: -0.01
      max_traffic: 0.10
```
opsbot: deploy-bot: promotion started for model v2.4-int8-lite to 5% at 1968456789 :rocket:
samir: please run the heldout legal prompts (<=1024 ctx) and report hallucination rate and answer-safety checks.
maya: ran a quick smoke: hallucination_rate up 0.9% (baseline 0.4%) — +0.5 absolute. more thorough run in progress.
qa-bot: autotest summary for exp-2026-03-20-01: exact_match -1.9%, rouge-L -0.7, hallucination +0.5% -> recommend rollback.
aj: propose immediate traffic reduction to 1% and enable shadow compare + full quant-sweep. if metrics don't improve, full rollback.
diane: agree. reduce to 1% and enable "aggressive" fallback policy that routes flagged legal queries to v2.3-baseline.
maya: doing traffic shift to 1% now, enabling shadow logs and labeled seed set.
opsbot: deploy-bot: update: traffic for v2.4-int8-lite set to 1% at 1968456860 :white_check_mark:
samir: also create a canary gating ticket for a longer eval window (48h) and add seeded legal prompts; ping @platform for extended metrics retention.
maya: filed ML ticket ML-2390 with seeds, logs, and evals: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-2390 — added note to rollback if qa_exact_match <= -1.0% after 24h.
aj: thanks — let's rebaseline with quant-rc2 before any further promotion. :thumbsup:
